build_mae_vit_base_model: build a MaskedAutoencoderViT base model with 768 embed dim and 12 transformer blocks
build_mae_vit_large_model: build a MaskedAutoencoderViT large model with 1024 embed dim and 24 transformer blocks
run_forward_encoder: run the MAE encoder on image patches with random masking at a given mask ratio
run_forward_decoder: run the MAE decoder to reconstruct masked patches from the encoder latent representation
run_forward_loss: run the MAE reconstruction loss computation comparing predicted patches against original image patches
